source.treeEquality: The tested feature head and final squash merge have identical trees. cloud-release was advanced by an expected-old-SHA guarded fast-forward from the base commit.

fix: html/body clip horizontal document overflow and disable horizontal overscroll. Vertical scrolling, map pan and local scrolling controls remain available. No schema, authentication, provider, content or navigation changes.

design.impeccable: Actual installed Impeccable skill/context/adapt/craft floor used; audited cloud evidence and source before release.
design.changedCapture: Only 390-place.png differed. Inspection showed focused fixed elements and hover at different capture scroll positions; a normalized local before/after layout comparison confirmed identical geometry.
design.localLayoutChecks: 80 Chromium/WebKit route, viewport and engine combinations at 320/390/844/1280px passed.
design.touchEvidence: Synthesized Chromium touch on the deployed site confirmed vertical scrolling, no page displacement after horizontal swipes in either direction, and independent map panning.
liveViewsInspected: additional Chromium 390 events and map drag

limitations: Physical-phone testing remains unverified; browser evidence uses emulation and synthesized touch.
outcome: PR17 merged, released to the established stable QA site, and verified live.
